_about: Public-domain Dame Gertrude More (1606-1633), English Benedictine of Cambrai and great-great-granddaughter of Thomas More, for the Word Hoard: The Writings of Dame Gertrude More, revised and edited by Dom Benedict Weld-Blundell (imprimatur 1910), from an Internet Archive scan. She wrote in English. The companion volume is Augustine Baker's Life of her, by another hand. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
